# WHY THERE IS NO out-main-debug.txt IN THIS DIRECTORY
# The issue asks whether the project publishes macOS release binaries.
# A compiler cannot answer that: a dxc that works perfectly and is
# never uploaded to a release is precisely the reported situation. The
# evidence is therefore release metadata and build configuration, in
#   manual-case-release-assets.txt
#   manual-case-ci-and-repo-config.txt
#   manual-case-github-thread.txt
# The build is identified below only so that 'not measured' is visibly
# a decision rather than an omission.

# present: True
$ build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe --version
    dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5433-ab540090)(1.9.0.5433) - 1.9.0.5433 (triage, ab5400907)
    [exit 0]

# PROVENANCE CAVEAT - read this before citing the SHA above.
# The binary self-reports '(triage, ab5400907)'. ab5400907 is a
# fork-local merge commit orphaned by a history rewrite; it resolves
# to nothing and must not be cited. The compiler sources this build
# was made from are byte-identical to upstream main
# 13730886e6a9019e4e0823746470f3ab75341d6b, which is the commit cited
# in notes.md, comment.md and verdict.json. SKILL.md's tree check
# (section 0 of manual-case-ci-and-repo-config.txt) is what
# establishes that: 0 paths differ outside the triage skill directory.
